integrity: All analytical claims follow from explicit Schur complement and Choi arguments; numerical checks support but do not replace these proofs; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The spectral bound is necessary and sufficient for uniform covariance physicality over all admissible inputs, not for individual steady states or trajectories.
The separate CPTP threshold is for a bath-local one-mode qubit channel implementing the prescribed second-moment rule; no multimode CPTP or Gaussianity claim is made.
Thermal evaluation assumes a bounded one-particle bath Hamiltonian; finite-chain and infinite-band edges differ.
title: Sharp physicality thresholds for coherence-retaining fermionic reservoir resets
